description.zh:
导播台ID，请确保传入的CasterId是正确的。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio. Make sure that the CasterId is correct.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, obtain the ID from the CasterId parameter in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** and choose **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to view the ID.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.

title.zh: 查询导播台流信息列表

descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，再调用本接口查询导播台流地址，否则会返回InvalidScene.NotFound错误。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, call the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation to create a production studio. If a production studio has not been created, the InvalidScene.NotFound error is returned.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 5 for each user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-caster-stream-url --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
